title: Create frontend GraphQL query definition for Define page
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/lib/graphql/queries/define.ts` with the DEFINE_VIEW_QUERY.

Follow the pattern of existing query files like `analytics.ts` and `budget.ts` in the same directory.

Export a `gql` tagged template literal containing the full defineView query with all nested fields as specified in the tech spec's Basic Example section. Include the optional `$feature: String` variable.

All field names should use camelCase (GraphQL convention) matching the Strawberry auto-conversion from snake_case Python types.
acceptance_criteria:
- DEFINE_VIEW_QUERY is exported as a gql tagged template literal
- Query includes optional $feature: String variable
- Query requests all fields: visionStatus, visionPath, features with nested specified/built/gap, defects, aggregates
- Field names use camelCase matching Strawberry's auto-conversion
- File follows the same pattern as existing query files in the directory

Human guidance: Previous scope violations were false positives caused by a diff-base bug that has been fixed. Build the frontend GraphQL query definition as specified.
rationale: The query definition is a standalone frontend artifact with no dependencies on other frontend tasks. Creating it early allows the page task to import it immediately.
decisions: Modeled interfaces after spec-alignment.ts (the closest peer — same optional variable pattern). SpecDoc is a shared interface reused for productSpec/technicalSpec/designSpec to avoid repetition. DefineViewData wraps the query root so consumers can type useQuery<DefineViewData>.
The design spec change flagged by the reviewer was already absent from this refreshed branch — no revert was needed.
